news.title: ‘The Midwest is the place in the US for quantum sensing’
news.summary_en: Applied Materials chose Chicago for an October workshop aimed at accelerating the deployment of quantum sensors for industries that need them. They were drawn by the Midwest’s talent pipeline, research base, and ecosystem supports.

news.title: Chicago Business Journal: Blueprint for the future: Chicago Quantum Exchange's new CEO outlines the next phase for quantum tech
news.summary_en: The Chicago Quantum Exchange leader highlights a shift toward commercial manufacturing where 70% of future roles may not require graduate degrees.

news.title: Argonne’s Advanced Photon Source illuminates the quantum world within materials
news.summary_en: Researchers use cutting-edge X-ray capabilities to peer deep inside quantum materials in real time as they grow and transform
